name: Invoice PDFs from email to a spreadsheet, with a sum check

parameters.jsCode:
// Two made-up mails shaped like the Gmail trigger's output: attachments arrive as attachment_0, attachment_1, ...
const PDF = {"HP-2207.pdf": "", "INV-1041.pdf": "", "PC-3315.pdf": ""};
const MAILS = [{"json": {"from": "billing@northwind.example", "subject": "Invoices for November"}, "files": {"attachment_0": "INV-1041.pdf", "attachment_1": "HP-2207.pdf"}}, {"json": {"from": "invoices@peakcloud.example", "subject": "Your Peak Cloud invoice PC-3315"}, "files": {"attachment_0": "PC-3315.pdf"}}];
return MAILS.map(({ json, files }) => ({ json, binary: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(files).map(([key, fileName]) =>
  [key, { data: PDF[fileName], mimeType: 'application/pdf', fileName, fileExtension: 'pdf' }])) }));
